words.def: to check that information is correct or true
words.ex: Could you {verify} the time of the appointment before we finish the call?

words.def: to succeed in reaching someone by phone
words.ex: I tried three times before I {got through}.

words.def: to give information to someone else
words.ex: Can you {pass on} the message to your manager?

words.def: to connect a caller to another person
words.ex: The assistant {put me through} to the right department.

words.def: difficult to understand, hear or follow
words.ex: Her instructions were {unclear} over the phone.

words.def: a further action or contact after an earlier one
words.ex: He sent a {follow-up} email after the call.

words.def: used to introduce information from another source
words.ex: {According to} the caller, the meeting is on Friday.

words.def: used when reporting what you heard from someone else
words.ex: {Apparently}, the delivery was delayed by two days.
